verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms docs.blaxel.ai/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a curated documentation index. The docs are also served as raw Markdown pages (e.g. Overview.md, Sandboxes/MCP.md), and Blaxel ships agent-oriented skills plus a skills/MCP docs page meant for agents to consume. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or equivalent full-content dump, and no independent user corroboration of agents consuming these docs effectively.
